headline: Enkei Corporation Files Report on Ransomware Incident
body: In a recent regulatory filing, Enkei Corporation disclosed details of a ransomware attack that affected its production control systems. The automotive components supplier reported that it has shifted to manual operations while other units remain unaffected. The filing also mentioned Enkei Corporation's efforts to warn contacts about potential fraudulent messages. The company has engaged incident response teams to address the situation and is working towards restoring its automated systems.
